data.one_liner: Redux extension to reduce boilerplate with compact actions and inline reducers.
data.what_it_does: Redux Compact reduces boilerplate for Flutter Redux applications by combining actions and reducers into a single CompactAction class. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous actions with direct access to state and dispatch functions.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app using Redux and want to eliminate separate files for actions and reducers.
You need to handle asynchronous requests cleanly inside a Redux action.
avoid_when: you are not using Redux in your Flutter application.
You prefer modern state management solutions like Riverpod or Bloc.
strengths: Eliminates separate action and reducer boilerplate files.
Built-in support for asynchronous requests and request statuses.
Action chaining capabilities with before and after hooks.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Redux architecture.
Mixing business logic and state reduction inside action classes can lead to large files if not structured carefully.
data.setup_notes: Add compactReducer and compactMiddleware to your Redux Store.
